title: Trace of L ∘ p as a sum over the standard basis
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with standard basis vectors e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1, P ⊆ E a linear subspace with orthogonal projection p := P.starProjection, and L : E → E a continuous linear map. Then Σ_{k ∈ Fin N} ⟨L(p e_k), p e_k⟩ = trace(L ∘ p), where the trace is LinearMap.trace ℝ E of the linear map L ∘ p.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), ∑ k : Fin N, inner ℝ (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)))) (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (L.toLinearMap ∘ₗ P.starProjection.toLinearMap)
